description: This file contains utility functions for registering and handling sharded tensor operations in PyTorch's distributed module, including common logic for sharded operations and dispatch on local shards.

methods.name: _sharded_op_common
methods.description: Provides common logic for sharded tensor operations, including validation, optional extra checks, and early stopping.

methods.name: _register_sharded_op_on_local_shards
methods.description: Registers a sharded tensor operation to be applied on local shards, with support for customization and dispatch.
